The inverter reuses current, giving gm=gmn+gmp. Widths are set so VGS matches the 0.75 V input DC, a short L sets gain near 18-20 to keep BW, and vout_dc is solved numerically. A 2.4 V swing is impossible on a 1.8 V rail."}

PARAMS = {
    "Itot":  (37e-6, 15e-6, 38.3e-6),   # inverter current (power-limited)
    "Ln":    (0.30, 0.15, 1.0),          # nfet L: sets gain vs BW
    "Lp":    (0.35, 0.15, 1.0),          # pfet L
    "kbal":  (1.0, 0.7, 1.4),            # pfet width trim for output centering
    "vout_t":(0.9, 0.6, 1.2),            # intended output DC used for sizing vds
}

def _size_at_vgs(lut, dev, L, Id, vgs_t, vds):
    # bisection on gm/Id so that |VGS| == vgs_t at current Id
    lo, hi = 3.0, (24.0 if dev == "n" else 15.8)
    op_hi = lut.size(dev, hi, L, Id, vds=vds)
    if abs(op_hi.vgs) > vgs_t:          # cannot get that low: weakest-inversion limit
        return op_hi
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        op = lut.size(dev, mid, L, Id, vds=vds)
        if abs(op.vgs) > vgs_t:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return lut.size(dev, 0.5 * (lo + hi), L, Id, vds=vds)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["Itot"]; vo = p["vout_t"]

    mn = _size_at_vgs(lut, "n", p["Ln"], I, vin, vo)
    mp = _size_at_vgs(lut, "p", p["Lp"], I, vdd - vin, vdd - vo)
    Wn, Wp = mn.W, mp.W * p["kbal"]

    # solve actual output DC: Idn(vout) = Idp(vdd - vout)
    def f(v):
        a = lut.op("n", Wn, p["Ln"], vin, v)
        b = lut.op("p", Wp, p["Lp"], vdd - vin, vdd - v)
        return abs(a["Id"]) - abs(b["Id"])
    lo, hi = 0.05, vdd - 0.05
    for _ in range(50):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if f(mid) > 0: hi = mid
        else: lo = mid
    vdc = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    on = lut.op("n", Wn, p["Ln"], vin, vdc)
    opp = lut.op("p", Wp, p["Lp"], vdd - vin, vdd - vdc)
    Iact = abs(on["Id"])

    # ibias sink: small diode-connected nfet
    m0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(Wn, 3), p["Ln"])
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", round(Wp, 3), p["Lp"])
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)

    gm = on["gm"] + opp["gm"]
    gds = on["gds"] + opp["gds"]
    cpar = mn.cdd + mp.cdd * p["kbal"] + 2 * (mn.cgd + mp.cgd * p["kbal"])
    ctot = cl + cpar
    A = gm / gds
    f3 = gds / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    power = vdd * (Iact + iref)
    swing = min(1.6, 2 * 0.3 * A * 0.5)  # rough: limited by rails
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vdc, "swing": swing}
